snippet.title: Turfagon - Trailer (scan to play) | GPS Mafia Game
snippet.description:
Turfagon is a mafia game you play by driving your real city. Your streets are split into hexagons called turfagons. Drive through one and it's yours, then hold it, because the rival Families want your city too.

I'm a solo indie dev, and I built this on my delivery routes. Scan the code in the video, or tap the link:

Try the free demo in your browser: https://turfagon.com/?from=youtube
Get the full game in my shop: https://ko-fi.com/bubbalove/shop

Rated 17+ (mob crime, violence, adult humor). Never play while you drive: everything counts on its own.

A Pyrrhic Studios game. - BubbaLove
